name: Katarina
source:
Main heroine gets a job at a new large company and visits chairman's hall. She is greeted by a butler and mysterious garden caretaker. The curtains of the tragedy get opened.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角在一家新成立的大型企业找到工作，前往董事长宅邸。迎接她的是管家和神秘的庭园管理员。悲剧的帷幕就此拉开。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
